it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura em 02/04/2026, quando Cícero Lucena renunciou ao cargo para disputar a eleição de 2026 para governador da Paraíba. A posse formal foi em 06/04/2026, em sessão da Câmara Municipal.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and became mayor on April 2, 2026, when Mayor Cícero Lucena resigned to run for governor of Paraíba state in the 2026 election. He was formally sworn in on April 6, 2026, at a session of the City Council (the city's legislature).
